interfaces.name: qualification_authority
interfaces.notes: sole trusted issuance; digest-bound; evidence mandatory

interfaces.name: certificate_store
interfaces.notes: trusted-flag + registry checksum; durable revocation; reissue requires requalified=True

interfaces.name: execution_authorization
interfaces.notes: PRE-DISPATCH contract (schema 1.1.0): binds qualification evidence (scope, digests, certificates, shared-core acceptance, canary/circuit-breaker readiness, revocation, dispatch limits); NEVER depends on experiment results — consumed by the IJ-NANO runner at a pinned IJEVAL revision; fail-closed with no registered evidence

interfaces.name: publication_authorization
interfaces.notes: POST-EXECUTION contract (schema 1.0.0, unchanged semantics): consumes a qualified AggregationReport; NOT a pre-dispatch requirement (v1.1.0 separation)

interfaces.name: canary_scheduler
interfaces.notes: EA09: controls through the PRODUCTION evaluation path; cadence 25 trials / 5 min preregistered; canaries counted, never model observations

interfaces.name: boundary_quarantine
interfaces.notes: quarantine classification + duplicate/critical blocking IMPLEMENTED; restart-safe recovery scope (EA10) PLANNED

interfaces.name: aggregation_boundary
interfaces.notes: scope certification + roster reconciliation + publication-time snapshot recheck

n03_batch_a.confirmation_protection: confirmation expectations are consumed only by the trusted qualification path (reference oracle + certificate issuance); they are never passed to parsers, model-facing prompts, runner configuration or optimizer-visible structures

authorization_rule: N03 (and any runner scope) is authorized ONLY by eval_assurance.compat.authorization.authorize_runner(...) returning RunnerAuthorization.allowed=True bound to scope, coverage, certificate digests and snapshot checksum; a PASS string or bare certificate object authorizes nothing
